messages:
olivia: Promo to prod blocked — deploy-bot failing to attach manifest. Getting persistent GCS temp object leases in staging artifacts. Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: on it. which job and artifact id?

olivia: deploy-bot promo job #4217, artifact key staging/build-2026-03-15/sha256:abcd1234. gsutil shows temp objects: gs://redwood-artifacts-temp/staging/abcd1234.lock

raj: weird — thought we cleaned those up. paste deploy-bot logs?

deploy-bot: Promotion attempt 4217 -> prod failed: manifest attach timed out (504). Retrying in 30s. (attempt 3/3)

maria: I'm seeing a batch of stale leases from a previous upload window. Possibly caused by parallel retry storm when registry responded 503. Recommend manual cleanup + pin last-good image for immediate unblock.

sam: trying quick probe:
```
gsutil ls -L gs://redwood-artifacts-temp/staging/abcd1234.lock
  Size: 0 
  Owner: service-account@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  Metadata:
    lease-id: 0x7f6a2c
    created: 2026-03-15T03:12:11Z
```

sam: lock shows lease bit set. Running `gsutil acl ch -u deploy-bot@redwood:O` to try unstick.

olivia: timeline decision? We have a change window ending in 40m.

maria: plan: 1) manual rm of temp objects, 2) pin promote to last-good digest (prod-ready), 3) follow-up incident to root-cause parallel retry logic. I can do rm if ops ok.

raj: +1 for pin. If manual rm, keep a snapshot list so we can audit.

sam: rm done. Confirmed `gsutil ls` no more lock objects.

deploy-bot: Promotion retry succeeded on attempt 4. Promo completed — prod image = sha256:abcd1234 (pinned).

olivia: thanks. we'll keep this pin in release notes and backport a retry-serialization fix to deploy-bot. filing a postmortem.

maria: filing incident -> INC-2026-042, linking to this thread.

olivia: closing thread. :tada:
